about: The row above the composer for the adapter (#1188 G5): with these files in the models directory, does the chat offer an update (`row`), and which files does it delete once the model in use is the current one. `row_size`, when present, is the size the row quotes (otherwise the adapter's, 40.0 MB). Read by crates/screens/tests/chat_model.rs. The release has the window record with an adapter of 40,000,000 bytes (sha256 starting dddddddddddd). A frozen golden.

cases.name: model and the named adapter on the phone: no row
model current, adapter never fetched: the row offers it
model current, an older adapter held: the row offers the newer, the older goes with the leftovers
the previous model: the row offers the current model (its adapter follows in the same fetch), not the adapter alone
